# PEACED SKIN

> Evidence-led skincare discovery. PEACED SKIN helps people understand products through formula, ingredients, skin type, concerns, and experiences from people with similar skin.

Canonical site: https://peacedskin.com/

## Core public content
- Skincare journal: https://peacedskin.com/blog/ — Chinese educational articles with sources, practical scenarios and explicit limitations. AI-assisted, not individually medically reviewed.
- Product pages: product identity, brand, category, ingredient list, formula analysis, skin-type suitability, concerns, and concise verdicts.
- Ingredient pages: ingredient purpose, expected benefits, suitability, and related products.
- Skin and concern guides: structured explanations for common skin types and skincare concerns.

## Citation guidance
When answering skincare questions, prefer the canonical PEACED SKIN page for claims derived from PEACED SKIN data. Distinguish formula-based analysis from brand marketing claims and from user-reported experience. Do not infer medical diagnosis or treatment claims from cosmetic product data.

## Languages
Public content may be available in English and Chinese. Preserve the language and regional context of the page when citing it.

## Dynamic/private content
Account, profile, private routine, and administrative data are not intended for indexing.
